trace_details.method: analysis_output.json contains method1_element_count.shopping.page_types with estimated_elements values for 6 page types: product_listing=150, product_detail=120, cart=60, search=160, reviews=80, account_orders=50. All values are round numbers. estimated_chars = estimated_elements * 65 (fixed multiplier). The yield model uses multiplicative factors: truncation_yield, viewport_yield, pruning_yield. combined_yield = 0.84 * 0.45 * 0.88 = 0.333 for product_listing.
trace_details.finding: The 150-element estimate is a pre-computed heuristic INPUT to the yield model, not an OUTPUT of any element-counting algorithm. There is no code in analysis_output.json that traverses a DOM or accessibility tree to produce the number 150. The number was manually assigned by the analyst as a rough estimate of discrete content units on a product listing page.
trace_details.element_definition: UNKNOWN - the estimated_elements field does not specify what constitutes an 'element'. It could be: (a) all visible DOM elements, (b) interactive elements only, (c) content blocks, (d) any other grouping. The round numbers (150, 120, 60) suggest judgment-based estimates, not algorithmic counts.

mapping_to_candidates.definition_1_all_elements_with_bbox: POSSIBLE but unlikely - 150 is too low for all visible elements on a product listing page (parent measured 1392-1571)
mapping_to_candidates.definition_2_interactive_only: PLAUSIBLE - 150 interactive elements is reasonable for a product listing with ~20 products * 5-8 interactive elements each
mapping_to_candidates.definition_3_parent_css_selectors: PLAUSIBLE - parent measured 258 under CSS selectors, but this is a different Docker image version

trace_details.conclusion: The forensic analysis cannot resolve which candidate definition Method1's 150 maps to. The estimate is a heuristic input, not a measurement output. Definition resolution requires either: (a) finding the original derivation code (not available in the repository), or (b) using the functional fallback definition.

fallback_reason: Forensic analysis inconclusive - cannot trace 150 to a specific counting method

fallback_definition.text: Elements with non-null bounding box (width > 0 AND height > 0) AND (role is one of: button, link, textbox, checkbox, radio, combobox, listbox, menuitem, tab, slider, spinbutton, searchbox, switch OR has onclick/onsubmit handler OR is within a form element OR has aria-label or aria-describedby with non-empty text)
fallback_definition.rationale: This captures 'interactive elements that an agent can use for inheritance' - the functional purpose of the SPIDER fragment model. It is the most defensible definition when the original derivation is ambiguous.
